keep.text: Mujhe ye samajhne mein 5 saal lag gaye ki health mein sabse bada problem
information nahi hai, implementation hai.
Aap jaante ho ki aapko kya khana hai, aap jaante ho ki aapko exercise karni hai, aap jaante ho ki stress bilkul kharab cheez hai,
par karte ho na?
Rukta nahi hai na.
Kyunki aapke paas koi system nahi hai, koi sequence nahi hai. Aaj diet kiye, kal chhod diye.
Gym gaye do hafte, teen hafte, phir uske baad chhoot gaya.
Fasting ki
toh
randomly kisi bhi din kar liya.
Aur meditation? Kal se karunga bhai.
Aaj samajh mein nahi aaya,
kal aankh band karke thoughts aa rahe hain,
kuch samajh mein nahi aa raha.
Koi information nahi hai? Information aapki
YouTube pe free mein padi hui hai.
Jo nahi hai,
personalized system aapke paas nahi hai, jo daily bataye ki aaj kya karna hai, kal kya karna hai, parson kya karna hai. Agar is system se aap logon ko saari cheezein mil jaayein
toh aap logon ko ye saari cheezein pata chal jaayengi.
Isi liye maine ye protocol banaya hai. Fasting plus diet plus exercise plus meditation, chaaron ka ek poora ka poora personalized system
daily time table ki tarah aap logon ko milega.
Ghar se karo, chahe gym se karo, chahe kahin se karo, poori duniya mein.
Mera result
main aap logon ko dikha raha hoon. 110 kilo se
85 kg kaise aaya hoon, aap logon ko ye saamne dikh raha hai.
10% body fat maine 30 din mein ghata diya hai.
Maine apni wife ka BP lifestyle change karne se normalize kar diya hai.
Doctor ki guidance mein hum logon ne ye saari cheezein amal kiya hai. Mummy ka psoriasis bahut behtar hua hai
sirf aur sirf lifestyle change karne se.
Teen log, ek system, teen different problems, aaram se fix ho gaye.
Aur mujhe ye system banane aur samajhne mein 5 saal lag gaye,
but aapko sirf aur sirf ek webinar mein ye saari cheezein mil jaayengi.
Link neeche hai, milte hain
aap logon se webinar mein!
